data.text/markdown:
SAFT-VRQ Mie: additive vs. non-additive hard spheres for He/H||(_2||)

Impact of the non-additive hard-sphere correction on the He/H||(_2||) phase behaviour with SAFT-VRQ Mie (FH1).
  • non-additive (default, inc_nonadd_term=True): BMCSL reference with the like diameters ||(d_{ii}||) plus the first-order non-additive correction for ||(d_{ij} \neq (d_{ii} + d_{jj})/2||), where ||(d_{ij}||) is the Barker-Henderson diameter of the effective unlike pair potential.
  • additive (inc_nonadd_term=False): BMCSL reference only.
Parameters: Aasen et al. (2019) pure, with ||(k_{ij} = l_{ij} = 0||) (predictive) and with the Aasen et al. (2020) binary parameters (||(k_{ij} = 0.08||), ||(l_{ij} = -0.05||)). Component 0 is helium. Note: the Aasen et al. (2020) ||(k_{ij}||) and ||(l_{ij}||) were fitted with the non-additive hard-sphere correction. The "additive HS, Aasen 2020" model therefore uses binary parameters that were not fitted for it, so its comparison with the non-additive model is somewhat unfair: it shows how much the published fit depends on the correction term, not the best additive SAFT-VRQ Mie result.

Hard-sphere diameters ||(d_{ij}||) in the dispersion term

Checked in the feos source (crates/feos/src):
model ||(d_{ij}||) (||(i \neq j||)) in the dispersion term non-additive HS correction
SAFT-VRQ Mie (saftvrqmie) always non-additive: Barker-Henderson diameter of the effective unlike FH-Mie potential optional (inc_nonadd_term, default on)
SAFT-VR Mie (saftvrmie) always additive: ||(d_{ij} = (d_{ii} + d_{jj})/2||) none
SAFT-VR-CS (saftvrcs_mie) non-additive or additive, set by non_additive_hs coupled to non_additive_hs
  • SAFT-VRQ Mie: TemperatureDependentProperties computes hs_diameter_ij(i, j) for all pairs by integrating the unlike potential qmie_potential_ij (saftvrqmie/eos/hard_sphere.rs, saftvrqmie/eos/mod.rs). The dispersion term uses this matrix in ||(\zeta_x = \frac{\pi}{6} \rho_s \sum_{ij} x_{s,i} x_{s,j} d_{ij}^3||) and in ||(x_{0,ij} = \sigma_{ij}/d_{ij}||) (saftvrqmie/eos/dispersion.rs). inc_nonadd_term=False only drops the Non additive Hard Sphere contribution; the dispersion term is unchanged.
  • The BMCSL hard-sphere term of SAFT-VRQ Mie uses only the like diameters ||(d_{ii}||) (additive) in both cases.
  • SAFT-VR Mie: d_ij = (diameter[i] + diameter[j]) * 0.5 in saftvrmie/eos/dispersion.rs.
In this notebook, "additive HS" for SAFT-VRQ Mie therefore means an additive hard-sphere reference only, not a fully additive model as in SAFT-VR Mie.

data.text/markdown:
SAFT-VR-CS: additive vs. non-additive hard spheres

SAFT-VR-CS with the Ziegler parameters (parameters/saftvrcs/saft_vr_cs_params.json), ||(k_{ij} = \gamma_{ij} = 0||), classical route to the unlike parameters (see saftvrcs_mixtures.py):
  1. SAFT-VR Mie combining rules on the classical pure-component parameters: ||(\sigma_{ij}||), ||(\varepsilon_{ij}||), ||(\lambda_{r,ij}||).
  2. Pair quantities: ||(D^*_{ij} = \hbar^2 / (12\, m_{ij}\, k_\mathrm{B} T\, \sigma_{ij}^2)||) with ||(m_{ij} = 2 m_i m_j / (m_i + m_j)||), prefactors ||(\zeta^X_{ij} = (\zeta^X_i + \zeta^X_j)/2||).
  3. Effective unlike parameters from the ansatz functions: ||(X_{\mathrm{eff},ij} = X_{ij}\, F^X(D^*_{ij}, \lambda_{r,ij}; \zeta^X_{ij})||).
This route corresponds to SAFT-VRQ Mie, where the Feynman-Hibbs correction acts on the combined classical unlike pair.
  • non-additive (non_additive_hs=True, default): ||(d_{ij}||) from the effective unlike pair potential in the dispersion term plus the non-additive hard-sphere correction, as in SAFT-VRQ Mie.
  • additive (non_additive_hs=False): ||(d_{ij} = (d_{ii} + d_{jj})/2||) in the dispersion term and no correction, i.e. fully additive as in SAFT-VR Mie.
Unlike SAFT-VRQ Mie, the switch here also changes the dispersion term.

data.text/markdown:
Fit of ||(k_{ij}||) and ||(l_{ij}||) for SAFT-VR-CS

Both binary parameters of the classical unlike pair, ||(\sigma_{ij} = (1 - l_{ij})(\sigma_i + \sigma_j)/2||) and ||(\varepsilon_{ij} = (1 - k_{ij})\, \sigma_i^{3/2} \sigma_j^{3/2} / \sigma_{ij}^3\, \sqrt{\varepsilon_i \varepsilon_j}||), are fitted separately for non-additive and additive hard spheres (||(\gamma_{ij} = 0||), classical route).
  • Objective: AARD of the bubble pressures at the experimental ||((T, x_\mathrm{He})||) (DDB, all references); points without a converged bubble point count as 100 %.
  • Nelder-Mead, starting at the SAFT-VRQ Mie values of Aasen et al. (2020), ||(k_{ij} = 0.08||), ||(l_{ij} = -0.05||).
  • About 7 s per objective evaluation, so each fit takes several minutes; the result is cached (kij_lij_fit_cs).
